title: Vantro Trading: markets have already adjusted, no damage

facts.subject: Orvan corridor agreement
facts.statement: Vantro Trading says grain markets have already adjusted to the end of the Orvan corridor agreement.

source_ref.text_snippet: Vantro Trading says grain markets have already adjusted to the end of the Orvan corridor agreement.

facts.subject: grain prices
facts.statement: Prices have settled and buyers have found alternative supply, the firm says.

source_ref.text_snippet: Prices have settled and buyers have found alternative supply, the firm says.

facts.subject: market status
facts.statement: Markets have adjusted; there is no damage left for our customers," said Samir Tolle, a trader at the firm.

source_ref.text_snippet: "Markets have adjusted; there is no damage left for our customers," said Samir Tolle, a trader at the firm.

facts.subject: company book status
facts.statement: The company says its own book is balanced for the rest of the year.

source_ref.text_snippet: The company says its own book is balanced for the rest of the year.

facts.subject: contract details
facts.statement: Vantro says its own book is balanced, but it does not show the positions or the terms of the substitute supply.

source_ref.text_snippet: Vantro says its own book is balanced, but it does not show the positions or the terms of the substitute supply.

facts.subject: delivery terms
facts.statement: The firm says it has honoured all delivery terms this quarter.

source_ref.text_snippet: The firm says it has honoured all delivery terms this quarter.

facts.subject: volume figures
facts.statement: Vantro declined to give volume figures.

source_ref.text_snippet: Vantro declined to give volume figures.
